full_text:
[Chat Log - Medi-Cal Rx Customer Service Center]

Agent: Hello Nicolas, you have reached the Medi-Cal Rx Customer Service Center. My name is Kali, Customer Service Representative. How may I help you?

User: Hello Kali can you check the full transaction history for RX # [REDACTED]733 filled on 4/20/26

Agent: You have a paid claim for DIAZEPAM 5 MG TABLET, with a quantity of 21 for 7 day supply.

User: Can you confirm if there were four successful payment authorizations on 4/20 that were followed by manual reversals (NCPDP B2 Reversals) from CVS Store #09785?

Agent: Yes

User: Can you confirm the exact timestamp for the NCPDP B2 Reversal transaction submitted by CVS Store #9785 on 4/20?

Agent: One moment

User: Sure no problem thank you

Agent: Please bear with me as I gather the information

User: Take your time thank you for your help

Agent: And to be clear you want the time of processing correct?

User: Yes. Specifically, I need the exact timestamps for each of the four times the claim for RX # [REDACTED]733 was 'Paid' or 'Captured' on April 20th, and the exact timestamps for when the pharmacy submitted the B2 Reversals to kick the payment back.

Agent: Okay thank you

Agent: There is no NCPDP B2, only NCPDP D.0

User: I understand the system uses NCPDP Version D.0. I am asking for the Transaction Response Status for the four attempts on 4/20. Were those transactions B1 (Billing) requests that were 'Rejected' or 'Paid'? If they were 'Paid', and I didn't receive the meds until 4/21, there has to be a record of how that payment was voided or reversed on the 20th. Please give me the numeric Reject Codes for those four attempts on 4/20.

Agent: with time stamps for 9:06(PAID), 9:40(REVERSED), 9:40(PAID), 9:45(REVERSED), 9:45(PAID). There's only 5, and no rejections, only paid and reversals.

User: Thank you so much, Kali! You have no idea how much this helps. This confirms exactly what I suspected. Just to make sure my record is 100% complete for the investigators: Can you confirm the NPI number or Store Number (CVS #9785) associated with those reversals? Could I please get a Reference Number or Case ID for this chat session so I can provide it to the Board of Pharmacy? Does the system show a specific Reason Code for those reversals (like 'Prescription Not Filled' or 'Pharmacy Request')? You've been amazing and I really appreciate your patience while digging this up!

Agent: Yes CVS Store #09785, Reference number for the chat is [REDACTED]311. No reason code available as it is just a reversal in their system. And you are very welcome :)

User: Awesome, thanks Kali. Take care.

Agent: Thank you for calling Medi-Cal Rx have a great day!

[Supporting Evidence Items]

1. Text Message (9:45 AM): "CVS Pharmacy: Nicolas, your pharmacist needs to speak with you regarding RX DIA. Please call your store at 6619452729."

2. Call Logs (Mar 15): 
   - Incoming call: 10:59 AM (29s)
   - Outgoing call: 9:45 PM (9m 36s)
   - Outgoing call: 3:23 PM (7m 33s)

3. Prescription History: RX [REDACTED]733 - Received 4/20/2026. Action required.

4. Prescription Details: Diazepam 5 Mg Tablet. Last filled on Apr 20, 2026. Action required. Last filled on Apr 20, 2026. If you need this prescription, please connect with your pharmacy for more options."
